questions.question: The parallel sides of a trapezium are 30 cm and 20 cm and its non-parallel sides are both equal. If the area of the trapezium is 300 cm², then what is the length (in cm) of each non-parallel side?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The parallel sides of a trapezium are 30 cm and 20 cm and its non-parallel sides are both equal. If the area of the trapezium is 300 cm²

**Concept used:**

Area of Trapezium = (1)/(2)( {a + b} )h

**Calculation:**

The parallel sides of a trapezium are 30 cm and 20 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e72bed7448114ea015df51af171d66423af7e73e5420e54d2d00a4bd76ac3ae8.png] 

Two non parallel sides are AB and CD which are equal in length.

Area of Trapezium = (1)/(2)( {a + b} )h

⇒ 300 = (1)/(2)( {20 + 30} )h

⇒ 25 × h = 300

⇒ h = 12 cm

The trapezium has two equal heights which are AE = DF = 12 cm

Now, Triangle DFC is a right angle triangle

Using Pythagoras theorem 

DC² = FC² + DF²

DC² = 5² + 12²

DC² = 169

DC = √169

DC = 13 cm

Length of each of two non parallel sides AB = CD = 13 cm.

questions.question: In a press, there are three types of printing machines, P, Q and R. Machine P can print 10,000 pages in 8 hours, machine Q can finish the same task in 10 hours and machine R can finish the same task in 15 hours. All the three machines start the work at 9 : 00 a.m. Machine P breaks down at 11 : 00 a.m. and machines Q and R finish the task. The approximate time of completion of the job is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a press, there are three types of printing machines, P, Q and R. Machine P can print 10,000 pages in 8 hours, machine Q can finish the same task in 10 hours and machine R can finish the same task in 15 hours. All the three machines start the work at 9 : 00 a.m. Machine P breaks down at 11 : 00 a.m. and machines Q and R finish the task.

**Concept used:**

Time and work

**Calculation:**

Time taken by three different machines 

P : Q : R = 8 : 10 : 15

Take LCM of (8, 10, 15) which is 120

Total work = 120 unit

Efficiency of P = 120/8 = 15 units/hour

Efficiency of Q = 120/10 = 12 units/hour

Efficiency of R = 120/15 = 8 units/hour

They all started the work at 9 : 00 am and P breaks down at 11 : 00 am

They all worked together for 2 hours

Total work completed

⇒ (15 + 12 + 8) × 2 = 70 unit

Remaining work

⇒ 120 - 70 = 50 unit

Remaining work will be completed by machine Q and R 

Remaining work

⇒ frac{{50}}{{12 + 8}} = (5)/(2) = 2.5 hrs

Total time taken by three machines

⇒ 11 : 00 am + 2.5 hrs = **1 : 30 p.m.**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6, a² + b² + c² = 30 and a³ + b³ + c³ = 165, then the value of 4abc is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If a + b + c = 6, a2 + b2 + c2 = 30 and a3 + b3 + c3 = 165

**Concept used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c) (a2 + b2 + c² - ab - bc - ca)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 6² = 30 + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 6/2 = 3

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c) (a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca)

⇒ 165 - 3abc = 6 × (30 - 3)

⇒ 165 - 3abc = 6 × 27

⇒ 3abc = 165 - 162

⇒ abc = 1

∴ 4abc = 4 × 1 = 4
